blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, Cebu — A morning gathering to commemorate a deceased family member turned fatal on Monday, October 12, when a 37-year-old man was allegedly stabbed to death by his drinking companion in Barangay Tubod, San Fernando. Police identified the victim, who was rushed to the Cebu Provincial District Hospital in Carcar City but was declared dead on arrival. According to the San Fernando Municipal Police Station, the incident occurred around 5:45 a.m. at the home of the victim’s sibling, where a group of friends had gathered to mark a relative’s death anniversary.
